name: Borja Giménez Larraz - § 16/1
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘including through measures such as introducing the principle of positive administrative silence for the issuance of building permits for new construction and renovation works,’, ‘calls on the Commission to urge the Member States to set out a goal to achieve housing permits within a deadline of 60 days to deliver decent, sustainable and affordable housing;’ ‘calls on the Member States to promote the delivery of housing’ and ‘priority’ and ‘allowing shorter procedures to be activated at national level and to introduce fast-track approval procedures’
part_context: Calls on the competent public authorities to provide the responsible institutions with adequate resources to ensure effective and timely handling of applications in order to ensure permitting processes are made faster and simpler, <del>including through measures such as introducing the principle of positive administrative silence for the issuance of building permits for new construction and renovation works,</del> except in cases involving safety of persons, environmental standards and protection measures or requirements for the preservation of cultural, historical, and archaeological or architectural heritage, which must be safeguarded; recalls the importance of participative planning processes and the social function of housing; calls on the Commission to urge the Member States to set out a goal to achieve housing permits within a deadline of 60 days to deliver decent, sustainable and affordable housing; calls on the Member States to promote the delivery of housing through priority action allowing shorter procedures to be activated at national level and to introduce fast-track approval procedures for housing projects deemed critical for addressing urgent shortages;
